**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Section 2.2 (p0013)**

Section 2.2 makes Vendor our "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — an open-scope exclusivity/field-of-use restriction on us, with no product-level definition, no term cap, and no carve-out for internal development or acquisitions. It also directly contradicts Section 2.1 (no purchase commitment) and Section 12.3 (Customer has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment).

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: delete Section 2.2 in full, with the narrowed fallback (named competing product, term only, 12-month cap, internal-development/acquisition carve-outs) offered in the comment if Vendor needs protection.
